description: For a labeled undirected tree, encode repeatedly removes the smallest live leaf and emits its neighbor until two remain. Decode counts occurrences, sets degree(v)=1+occ(v), repeatedly joins the smallest degree-one vertex to the next code symbol, then joins final leaves. Sort normalized output edges. Empty codes are disambiguated by explicit n=0,1,2.
